# UI Layout Requirements Checklist: Runner Row Detail Keeps Header Names Readable

**Purpose**: Unit-test the requirements of a cross-webview CSS layout fix — measurability, wrapping, overflow, accessibility, platforms, scope, verification, secrets — before implementation (PR reviewer audience, standard depth)
**Created**: 2026-11-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`, then run against the spec/plan/contract: every item was evaluated, failing items were fixed in the artifacts (noted inline), and every box is ticked.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are layout requirements defined for both the name column and the value column of the runner header list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-004] — FR-002 (sizing/alignment), FR-003 (name cap/wrap), FR-004 (value wrap).
- [x] CHK002 Is the horizontal-overflow rule stated for the whole panel, not just individual cells? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005] — FR-005: no horizontal scroll whatever the length.
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for every view that shares the defect pattern, and is the search for siblings recorded? [Completeness, Spec §Context, §FR-006, Research R3] — docs Parameters + Body fields (FR-006); sibling sweep recorded in Context and plan "Out of scope".
- [x] CHK004 Is the accessibility structure of the replacement header list specified (accessible name, name→value association)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010] — "Request headers" label, each name the term for its value.
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements stated for what must NOT change (content, order, masking, other tables)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK006 Are the visual properties outside layout (colours, fonts, theme, vertical scrolling, translation exclusion) declared unchanged? [Gap → fixed, Spec §Assumptions] — failed initially; added an Assumptions bullet.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "wide enough for typical header names" quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003] — cap = larger of 40% and 16 characters; examples named.
- [x] CHK008 Is the unit of the 16-character floor unambiguous (which font, does it scale)? [Ambiguity → fixed, Spec §FR-003] — failed initially; FR-003 now says "16 characters of the list's own monospaced text (so the floor scales with the text size)".
- [x] CHK009 Is the wrap order for over-long names precisely defined (hyphens/spaces first, mid-word last, never per character)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-001]
- [x] CHK010 Is the documentation Name cap expressed in a measurable unit, with its rationale? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Clarifications] — 32 characters; why not a percentage is in Clarifications and Research R3.
- [x] CHK011 Is "one line" vs "wrap" defined for the `required` marker in the documentation table? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006] — marker stays on the same line after the name.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Are the cap values consistent across spec, plan, contract, quickstart and tasks? [Consistency] — `max(40%, 16ch)` / "larger of 40% and 16 characters" everywhere; re-checked by grep after the analyze fix.
- [x] CHK013 Do the default-layout claims (panel width) agree with the app's real default layout? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Research R6] — 280 px default derived from `NewLayout` (sidebar 280 + right panel 320 at 1280 px) and the runner grid's `minmax(280px, 2fr)`.
- [x] CHK014 Is terminology consistent — "header list" for the runner, "Parameters table" for docs? [Consistency] — normalized during specify; "table" only refers to the docs table and other unaffected tables.
- [x] CHK015 Is the "wrap, never ellipsize" decision consistent across stories, FRs and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, US2, Assumptions] — product owner decision; T009 locks it.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Are success criteria objectively measurable without implementation knowledge? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-004] — line counts (5 lines, 1 line, 2 lines), 0 px horizontal scroll, body visible at 1280×800.
- [x] CHK017 Does each acceptance scenario name concrete inputs (header names, lengths, window size)? [Measurability, Spec §US1–US3] — 5 default headers, 61-char name, 400-char value, 51-char name, 1280×800.
- [x] CHK018 Is it stated which criteria are verified automatically and which by eye, given jsdom has no layout? [Measurability, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Test plan, Contract] — DOM/style contract in Vitest; line counts/overflow by eye with screenshots.

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are edge cases for no headers, empty value, many headers and masked values addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Is behaviour at the panel's minimum width specified — and does it match the default layout? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] — 280 px; all default names stay on one line thanks to the 16-character floor.
- [x] CHK021 Is a long unbroken name (no hyphen/space) addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] — breaks inside its cell only at the cap.
- [x] CHK022 Is the copy/selection behaviour of the restructured list addressed? [Gap → fixed, Spec §Assumptions] — failed initially; Assumptions now state names and values copy on separate lines and no copy action is added.

## Non-Functional: Accessibility, Platforms, Secrets

- [x] CHK023 Are keyboard/focus requirements stated for the restructured list? [Accessibility, Spec §Clarifications] — no new focus stops.
- [x] CHK024 Are the target webviews and the oldest supported engine named, with the CSS features constrained to them? [Platform, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Constraints] — WKWebView macOS 12+, WebView2, WebKitGTK; container query units excluded.
- [x] CHK025 Is cross-platform verification defined (by eye on macOS + CI on all three OSes)? [Platform, Spec §SC-005, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK026 Is it stated that secret masking is unaffected and fixtures carry no real secrets? [Security, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Constitution II] — masked `•••••` only.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK027 Are assumptions about unchanged panel size/position and the shared response viewer documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 Is the reason for having no Godog feature documented against the constitution? [Dependency, Plan §Complexity Tracking] — recorded per Governance; Vitest is the red-first gate.
